department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: The fall admission deadline is January 15, 2027; the spring deadline is September 15.

app_fee.value: The ECE page gives the international application fee as $95.
app_fee.quote: The application fee is $65 for domestic students and $95 for international students.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are requested from individual faculty members rather than the Graduate College, so you must ask a faculty member.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waivers are requested by individual faculty members.

gre_general.value: The GRE General is optional for ECE but highly recommended for applicants with weaker GPA or research experience, or with international transcripts.
gre_general.quote: (Optional) Official Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) General Test scores.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: The ECE page lists old-scale TOEFL scores (paper 60, internet 80), which are not recorded here.
toefl_min.quote: They are currently pBT: 60 or iBT: 80 for the TOEFL

ielts_min.value: The ECE page gives an IELTS minimum of 6.5, including IELTS Online.

supervisor.value: Admission and funding both require you to identify a willing faculty advisor before you apply.
supervisor.quote: Yes, admission and funding require students to identify a willing faculty advisor.

funding.value: The page says funding is available for incoming and continuing students but does not say that most or all students are funded.
funding.quote: The ECE PhD program has funding available for incoming and continuing students in the form of Teaching Assistantships (TAs) and Research Assistantships (RAs).

entry_route.value: The page allows transfer credit for a bachelor's or a master's, so both can enter the PhD.
entry_route.quote: The program allows students to transfer up to 9 credits for bachelors or 22 credits for a masters.

notes: Applications go through the Graduate College. The department's own FAQ quotes the old TOEFL scale, so no TOEFL number is recorded.
name: Electrical and Computer Engineering PhD
